short: Natural smooth short French Bulldog coat. Fine texture with modest realistic sheen. Crisp individual hair detail at edges; no soft blur halo.
fluffy: True French Bulldog Fluffy (not a long-coated spitz): modest short-to-medium fluff concentrated behind the ears and cheeks, lightly over the body, minimal tail fluff. Keep the compact French Bulldog silhouette and bat ears. Render fluffy fur as sharp, readable individual strands and soft volume — NOT blurry, smudged, motion-blurred, glowing, or frosted fringe. Outlining hairs must stay crisp against the transparent background. No soft-focus halo around the coat outline.
hairless: TRUE French Bulldog Hairless (Sphynx-like bare skin, not a shaved coated dog): ZERO fur, ZERO peach fuzz, ZERO coat sheen, ZERO hair texture. Coat color is almost entirely blocked. The body must read as skin only — light pink/cream flesh OR darker pigmented skin — with natural wrinkles and soft skin pores. Phenotype color/pattern/masking (brindle, merle, pied, sable, tan, solid color) may appear only as faint soft skin pigment blotches or freckles on a minority of the body, never as a bold patterned coat painted onto bald fur. Face may keep subtle darker muzzle/eye skin pigment. Keep compact French Bulldog identity, same pose/camera as other puppies.
big_rope_on: Big Rope anatomy: black nose leather, then immediately ONE single thick rope fold sitting flush on top of the nose — no thin extra crease between nose and rope. Do not keep a little fold plus a big fold. Keep rope size/thickness as requested; only remove or prevent the tiny lower crease. Keep eyes open, open nostrils, same identity.
big_rope_off: Do not invent an exaggerated nasal rope fold. Keep normal modest French Bulldog facial wrinkles only.
